floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 8 confirmed; 8 diffs are TWO independent reg-alloc/scheduling ties (inner sum/j $a0 swap; 2nd-loop LICM-const vs move preheader order) — both pure-C, greg-characterized, frontier built.
Region A quantified as a pure sum/j $a0<->$a1 swap (all surroundings match target); naive structural levers KILLED, pointing to the directed permuter.

Region A range-mechanism CONFIRMED: offset+=j flips the sum/j a0/a1 swap (score 7) but is not match-viable; zero-cost manual flips killed, so the flip needs the directed permuter's whole-function LUID
Directed permuter (real full-TU basin) found do-while(0) on sum=0 that solves Region A and lowers the honest floor 8->6; Region B has no clean permuter lever (all sub-130 finds invalid).
Fresh-seed floor-6 permuter (20.9k iters) + exhaustive preheader lineswap reconfirm no clean lever: Region A' tie unreachable by statement reorder, Region B yields only dead-alias cheats.

Forensics: both floor-6 residuals named to one GCC decision each (A'=sched.c rank_for_schedule INSN_LUID tiebreak coupled to the do-while(0) def-relocation; B=loop.c move_movables emit_insn_before(loo

Forensics: CORRECTED Region A mechanism — the do-while(0)'s sum=a0 flip is a loop-depth-weighted reg_n_refs TIE (10->11) broken by allocno number (sum 77<j 79), NOT live_length (LL=9 unchanged on both

Rederive: m2c goto-shape is score-equivalent to candidate (A' unmoved); tail-bracket A' decoupler cascades outer IVs (=12); Kengo match is name-only/unrelated. Region A' coupling reconfirmed structura

frontier.hypothesis: A whole-function structure gives sum weighted-n_refs >= 11 (tie/beat j) WITHOUT a loop-note bracket at sum=0's def AND without deepening the tail (which cascades i/chkptr/offset).
frontier.mechanism: reg_n_refs += loop_depth (flow.c): sum needs +1 depth-weighted ref over plain's 10. s8 proved it cannot come from the tail compare (cascade=12) nor from control-flow reshape (equivalent). It must come from a real depth>=1 sum reference in a block that does NOT contain the outer IVs, or from a genuine loop-carried sum use the target's semantics admit.
frontier.next_probe: Directed permuter on the floor-6 full-TU basin biased to accumulate-region restructures that add a real depth-2 sum reference (NOT sum=0's def, NOT the tail) - e.g. an inner-loop shape carrying a second live sum use; reject any synthetic/dead ref. Also probe splitting the accumulate into two depth-2 references of a single sum pseudo that GCC does not coalesce (s2's acc-split coalesced - seek a non-coalescing variant).

frontier.hypothesis: Drop j's loop-depth-weighted reg_n_refs from 11 to 10 so plain (low-LUID) sum=0 ties j and wins $a0 via the allocno tiebreak with NO do-while(0) at all (closes A and A' together).
frontier.mechanism: j total 11 = j=0(depth1) + j++(depth2) + j<0x24(depth2). Both depth-2 j refs are mandatory (target keeps sltiu ...,0x24 and the increment). j=0 at depth 0 would give 10 but j must reset each outer iteration.
frontier.next_probe: Find a loop shape where the counter is initialized once at function scope yet still resets per outer iteration without a depth-1 store, OR a pointer-difference reformulation that legitimately removes one depth-2 j reference while keeping target's sltiu ...,0x24 byte (prior pointer-end attempts diverged from target's integer counter).

frontier.hypothesis: Region B closes only if the two LICM range constants get LOWER LUID than the ap/a2p moves without a pre-loop reference (constant-holder cheat).
frontier.mechanism: loop.c move_movables emit_insn_before(loop_start) hard-codes the hoist point at preheader END (after the ap/a2p moves); the constants are referenced only inside the k-loop so LICM controls placement. Unchanged s1-s8.
frontier.next_probe: Design a k-loop where the range-test bound is genuinely loop-carried with a real dependency chain to the pointer moves (raising the moves' LUID above the constants), or where ap/a2p init is NOT a preheader insn (computed later/derived), so the hoisted constants become the first preheader insns. Vet against constant-holder/dead-alias.
